description: If you live in a city, finding a doctor is usually not a problem. You have options. Specialists, hospitals, urgent care clinics. Help is usually just a few minutes away.Rural Tennessee is different. In many communities, the nearest hospital is an hour's drive. Finding a specialist can mean traveling to Knoxville, Nashville, or Memphis.
